verdict.rationale: Debugging tools are a fair question for a coding agent, so this axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party way to attach to or debug a live running web application. The closest items are adjacent: MCP-client support that can 'interact with developer tools like your browser' through third-party servers, running local dev tools and commands, and passing error screenshots. None of these is a documented live-app debugging capability of Codex itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
